role: Development-guided refinement, not blind final testing
initial_ancestry: Public PAT training-image membership is unknown. No local20_29-adapted model used.
augmentation: Each training field: random512-768 crop resized to512, paired flips/90degree rotations; gain0.55-1.7, gamma0.75-1.3, occasional mild Gaussian blur. No geometric labels invented.
batch: 4 fields:2mixed-transition,1rotatingP/E/LR,1explicitBackground. Class-balanced CE+.5Dice. All batchnorm running stats frozen.
selection: Highest raw development mean Periderm/Endoderm IoU; score every50updates. Save full trace and never represent as an independent test. No forced left/right boundary.
target_for_success_on_this_crop: Both tissue recalls>=.85, both tissue precisions>=.85, labelled Background recall>=.98, tissue meanIoU>=.75. Even passing is not validation on hundreds of images.
